entries.label: I/O scheduler
entries.help: The algorithm that orders disk requests. mq-deadline is a safe default.

entries.label: Tunables
entries.help: Advanced options for the selected I/O scheduler.

entries.label: read_ahead_kb
entries.help: How far ahead the kernel reads from storage. Larger can help sequential reads.

entries.label: nr_requests
entries.help: How many requests can be queued for this device at once.

entries.label: rq_affinity
entries.help: Assigns I/O completion to the CPU that issued the request, improving cache locality.

entries.label: nomerges
entries.help: Controls whether the kernel merges adjacent disk requests.

entries.label: iostats
entries.help: Collect per-device I/O statistics. Disabling saves a little CPU.

entries.label: add_random
entries.help: Add disk timing to the kernel entropy pool. Disabling is usually fine on flash storage.
